# cloudflare-workers-cd-rollback

> GitHub Actions CD for Cloudflare Workers through cf with automatic traffic rollback on smoke failure, including JSON deployment snapshots, D1 migrations and prebuilt artifacts.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/cloudflare-workers-cd-rollback
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml

  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/cloudflare-workers-cd-rollback
```

then run `apm install`.
